contradictions.quote_a: Hazardous quarantine stays inside the ventilated 60 m2 hazmat cage within its 4,000 kg limit and is never mixed with general quarantine.
contradictions.quote_b: They are never placed back in the hazmat cage, in Zone B racking, in Zone C pick faces, or in general waste or the cardboard baler.
contradictions.explanation: One section requires hazardous quarantine to stay inside the cage while the other forbids placing contaminated hazmat back in the cage.

contradictions.quote_a: Unwrapped, part-wrapped, unstable or unlabelled pallets never enter Zone D.
contradictions.quote_b: Labelled packs are moved to Zone D dispatch staging, where pallets are wrapped on the semi-automatic stretch wrappers and staged for their assigned outbound door.
contradictions.explanation: One section forbids unwrapped pallets from entering Zone D while the other moves labelled packs into Zone D staging to be wrapped there.

contradictions.quote_a: General ambient lines go to bulk storage in Zone B, chilled lines go to Zone E, and hazardous lines go only to the ventilated 60 m2 hazmat cage
contradictions.quote_b: Restock from quarantine to Zone B, E or compliant Zone C locations is executed only after approval
contradictions.explanation: One section limits restock to Zone B, Zone E and the hazmat cage while the other allows restock to compliant Zone C locations.

violations.quote: inbound trucks unloaded and awaiting paperwork check
violations.explanation: The fact requires the document check to happen before unloading.

violations.quote: refer overtime, door changes and policy exceptions to the Shift Supervisor and Warehouse Manager
violations.explanation: The fact says the dispatcher assigns dock doors and time slots to carriers, not the Shift Supervisor and Warehouse Manager.
